description: PowerShell guard that keeps the default microphone volume at a chosen level.
notes: Run micvolumeguard -TargetPercent 100 to start the guard in the current console. Stop it with Ctrl+C.
Scoop does not create a scheduled task or start microphone monitoring during installation.
The upstream Install.cmd/Uninstall.cmd are optional manual task setup; remove any manually created task before uninstalling this package.
